note: Odd ID $09 made S3 use small-key slot 4 (= ID $08, Final Boss Route entrance $24) and DungeonMask read at byte offset 9 = $0008 (D7's compass/big key/map bits). $00: key slot $7EF37C (KeysSewer), mask $8000. Vanilla special case for $00: none; ID $02 aliases its keys to $00 (bank_02 $028254/$029B2E/$02A1CE, bank_09 $09F578). ID $02 is used by unplaced entrance $04 and by spawn points 2 (Prison, room $80) and 4 (Throne); the Prison spawn is only set by the D3 prison sequence (!ENABLE_D3_PRISON_SEQUENCE = 0). decisions.org 2026-09-27: '$04 = Sky tower; keyed dungeon ID $00 stays free'. The S3 entrance big-key door (room $53 north) stays open by the vanilla partner-door rule (room $43's south door is a normal door), so S3 is entered without a key; its own compass ($17) and big key ($32) now serve only S3 ($8000). Before this patch S3's big key wrote D7's bit $0008; D7's real big key is the $A2 knight drop. The game reads ZScream's bank-$0F entrance tables ($02:DA96 LDA $9800,X); the old table at $02:D48B is dead data that yaze still reads and writes (room_entrance.h), so it is updated too, to keep yaze/z3ed showing the live value.
